result.title: Capitulo 6.1 - AI in parametric upper-limb prosthetic customization
result.summary: Artificial intelligence is not currently being integrated into complete upper-limb prosthetic customization systems that combine all five components; instead, AI applications remain fragmented across individual elements, predominantly focusing on motor control through biosignal interpretation while lacking integration with parametric CAD workflows, AI-based parameter suggestion, and clinician oversight mechanisms.
